config.purpose: V7 protocol section 8.1: run the 6.0 default decoder with the opt-in stage counters on the unfitted V6 nanopore-like model (coverage 3/5/10/15) and two controls (deletion-heavy and illumina-like, coverage 10); report the per-stage funnel and the first failing stage of every non-EXACT decode (ground truth from the simulator). Descriptive; no algorithm or default changes. Must reproduce the V6 baseline 0/20 at nanopore-like coverage 3/5/10.
